cards.title: The Missing Chess Trophy
cards.briefing:
The school chess club's trophy has vanished from its glass display case.

The case was locked at 15:00 on Friday and found open, and empty, at 17:00. Only two people hold a key: Coach Lena Brandt and the caretaker, Marco Ruiz. The head teacher wants to know who took it, why, and where it is now — before Monday's assembly.

evidence.title: Head teacher's note
evidence.content: Display case checked and locked at **15:00** Friday. Found open at **17:00** by the cleaner. No damage to the lock. Keys: Coach Brandt, Mr Ruiz.

evidence.title: Interview: Marco Ruiz (caretaker)
evidence.content:
**Q:** Where were you between three and five?

**Marco:** Mopping the main corridor, half three till half four. Around quarter past four I saw the coach heading out with a big sports bag. She looked pleased with herself.

evidence.title: Interview: Lena Brandt (chess coach)
evidence.content:
**Q:** When did you leave on Friday?

**Lena:** About quarter to four. I had a dentist appointment, so I went straight there.

evidence.title: Lena Brandt's call log, Friday
evidence.content:
| Time | Number | Duration |
|---|---|---|
| 14:52 | Mum | 3 min |
| 16:05 | Silverline Engraving | 6 min |
| 16:58 | Pizza Roma | 2 min |

evidence.title: Receipt found in the staff room
Email from the dentist's office
evidence.content: We have no appointment for a Ms Brandt on Friday. Her next check-up is booked for next month.

questions.answer: To have this year's champions engraved on it as a surprise

cards.walkthrough:
Only the coach and the caretaker had keys, and Marco saw Lena leave at 16:15 with a large bag — half an hour after she claimed to have gone. Her call log shows a call to **Silverline Engraving** at 16:05, and the receipt (16:40, "Champions 2026", pickup Monday) shows what she did next. The dentist has no appointment for her, so the alibi was a cover story.

Lena took the trophy to have the new champions engraved as a surprise for Monday's assembly. It's safe at the engraver's.
